emulators._host_comment: 0.0.0.0 binds to every interface, not just loopback. Without it a physical phone on the same Wi-Fi cannot reach these ports — the emulators would only answer to the host machine itself.

pubsub._comment: Required for the scheduled functions (planPresencePings, dispatchPresencePings, flagAnomalies) to load. Without it the emulator skips them entirely. They still do not fire on their own schedule locally — trigger them by hand, see README.
